The complete 22-entry legend visibility vector, including deliberately hidden No Service and the originally hidden Out of Threshold band, remained identical. The full date, handset/network, technology and selected-band values read from the normal configuration controls matched exactly before and after; preservation-before-filters.png and preservation-after-filters.png show those forms, with clipped text supported by the retained control-value audit. HTTP Browsing and Video Streaming stayed hidden, Ping stayed visible, and all five original detail tabs remained unchanged. The same genuine MS Teams points request returned HTTP 200 with two identical aggregates before and after settings restoration. Route Replay was inactive before and after; this proves unchanged inactive state and does not claim populated Replay-session preservation. preservation-final-map.png shows routes and cells restored off, sites retained on and the two aggregate points. All test-owned changes were then removed and the original three layers, five tabs, active tab and exact viewport restored.
